s.g: (often attributive) Traditional Indonesian decorative technique in which warp or weft threads, or both, are tie-dyed before weaving.
A work woven in this style.
(uncountable) The Japanese art of flower arrangement.
(countable) An arrangement of flowers according to this art.
(slang, derogatory, ethnic slur, religious slur) A Jew.
(slang, derogatory, ethnic slur, religious slur) Having negative traits stereotypically associated with Jews; cunning, supercilious.
The Japanese concept of a reason for being, and having a sense of purpose based on one's interests and talents.
